_doc: Admin-only code excluded from the SERVED (consumer) build. The dev/full build (npm run build, GB_ADMIN default) keeps everything; the store/publish build (GB_ADMIN=0) skips 'entries', drops 'rootFiles' + 'contentScripts', strips /* @admin:start */.../* @admin:end */ regions from raw files, and regenerates the settings registry without 'configKeys'. 'leakTokens' must NOT appear anywhere in the packaged consumer output — the packager fails if they do.
